facts.why: The script has Ray asking about the high school plans and Allyson's friends confirming a Halloween dance, and later the police say they evacuated the dance.

facts.text: Mum says Grandma is paranoid. Grandma packed me snacks for the dance and said lock the back door on the way out.
facts.why: Karen dismisses Laurie and tells her to move on, and Allyson tries to keep a relationship with her grandmother. Nothing opened shows Laurie packing snacks or a dance.
facts.fix: Mum says Grandma is paranoid. Grandma never relaxes, and she told me to lock the back door on the way out.

facts.text: what Laurie pours herself the night the transfer hits the news
facts.why: Laurie drinks heavily all the time. She learns of the escape on the morning of October 31, after the bus crash on the night of October 30.
facts.fix: what Laurie pours herself most nights, forty years on

facts.text: Julian's pick, while Vicky's on the phone.
facts.why: Vicky does talk on the phone to Allyson while she babysits Julian, but nothing shows Julian choosing a snack, so the pick claim is unproven.
facts.fix: A babysitting snack while Vicky's on the phone.

facts.text: The awkward family dinner where Laurie turns up anyway.
facts.why: The plot has no restaurant or set dinner scene. The script has Laurie letting herself into Karen's house while Karen is preparing dinner for her family, and Karen telling her she is not welcome.
facts.fix: Karen's dinner at home, where Laurie turns up uninvited.
